title: Scenariji incidenata: od alarma do izvještaja
title_en: Incident scenarios: from alert to report
subtitle: Četiri realna incidenta koja povezuju gradivo više kurseva: phishing i kompromitovan nalog, procurjela tajna i zloupotreba AWS-a, napad na Kubernetes i incident sa AI agentom. U svakom pratiš napadača kroz logove, KQL, CloudTrail, audit logove i alarme, praviš vremensku liniju, obuzdavaš i pišeš izvještaj.
subtitle_en: Four realistic incidents that connect material from several courses: phishing and a compromised account, a leaked secret and AWS abuse, an attack on Kubernetes and an AI agent incident. In each one you follow the attacker through logs, KQL, CloudTrail, audit logs and alerts, build a timeline, contain the threat and write the report.

exam.note: Za scenarije nema zvaničnog ispita. Simulacija provjerava da li umiješ da povežeš dokaze iz različitih izvora; pravi rezultat su riješeni labovi i izvještaji.
exam.note_en: There is no official exam for the scenarios. The simulation checks whether you can connect evidence from different sources; the real outcome is the solved labs and reports.

domains.name: Phishing, kompromitovan nalog i lateralno kretanje
domains.name_en: Phishing, a compromised account and lateral movement

domains.name: Procurjela tajna i zloupotreba AWS-a

objectives.en: Phishing analysis: email headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, URLs and attachments as IOCs
objectives.bs: Analiza phishinga: zaglavlja poruke, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, URL-ovi i prilozi kao IOC-ovi

objectives.en: Sign-in investigation in KQL: impossible travel, MFA fatigue, suspicious IP addresses and session theft
objectives.bs: Istraga prijava u KQL-u: nemoguće putovanje, MFA umor, sumnjive IP adrese i krađa sesije

objectives.en: Lateral movement and persistence on a Linux host: auth.log, Wazuh alerts, authorized_keys, cron
objectives.bs: Lateralno kretanje i perzistencija na Linux hostu: auth.log, Wazuh alarmi, authorized_keys, cron

objectives.en: Containing the account and host, timeline and incident report
objectives.bs: Obuzdavanje naloga i hosta, vremenska linija i izvještaj o incidentu

objectives.en: Finding the source of the leak: git history, gitleaks, CI logs
objectives.bs: Pronalazak izvora curenja: git istorija, gitleaks, CI logovi

objectives.en: CloudTrail investigation: enumeration, privilege escalation, persistence
objectives.bs: Istraga CloudTraila: enumeracija, eskalacija privilegija, perzistencija

objectives.en: Damage assessment: access to S3 data, scope and impact
objectives.bs: Procjena štete: pristup S3 podacima, obim i uticaj

objectives.en: Containment and eradication in AWS, and a detection (Sigma) for the future
objectives.bs: Obuzdavanje i iskorjenjivanje u AWS-u i detekcija (Sigma) za ubuduće

objectives.en: Runtime alerts (Falco) and the entry point: a vulnerable image or application
objectives.bs: Runtime alarmi (Falco) i ulazna tačka: ranjiva slika ili aplikacija

objectives.en: Kubernetes audit log: ServiceAccount token abuse, exec, privileged Pods
objectives.bs: Kubernetes audit log: zloupotreba ServiceAccount tokena, exec, privilegovani podovi

objectives.en: The RBAC and configuration that made the attack possible
objectives.bs: RBAC i konfiguracija koja je omogućila napad

objectives.bs: Obuzdavanje (NetworkPolicy, izolacija, rotacija), hardening i izvještaj

objectives.en: Indirect prompt injection in a RAG source
objectives.bs: Indirektni prompt injection u RAG izvoru

objectives.en: Analyzing the agent's tool calls and data leakage
objectives.bs: Analiza poziva alata agenta i curenja podataka

objectives.en: Controls: tool guard, least privilege, human approval
objectives.bs: Kontrole: čuvar alata, najmanje privilegije, ljudsko odobrenje

objectives.bs: Obuzdavanje, izvještaj i mapiranje na OWASP LLM Top 10 i MITRE ATLAS
